package.name: omni_mcu
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 30): the Jetson's end of the MCU link. protocol.py (COBS + CRC frames, CMD / STATE / IMU, time sync; no ROS) mirrors firmware/lib/omni_fw/protocol.h; mcu_link publishes the MCU's odometry, IMU and state and sends the mode manager's commands at 100 Hz (USB serial on the robot, TCP to the sim's SIL firmware).
